name: dark-matter-replicators-reborn
title: Dark Matter Replicators Reborn
author: Honktown, Nihilistzsche, Jaer985
description: Replicators that produce almost any item from electricity, with dynamic recipe generation that works with any modlist. Five replicator tiers plus planetary variants for Space Age, quality support, and customizable balancing. Tenemut ore can come from a Dark Matter Synthesizer instead of the map. The Accelerator Ring turns tenemut into dark matter, the densest fuel in the game; the Annihilation Chamber burns it back into heat and the Annihilation Coil burns it straight into electricity. Optimized for high UPS.
